independent_recomputation: Direct native JSONL, no imported collector functions; canonical gold labels, 7600 unique indices/task, matching receipt prediction hashes for 24 G2 and 24 IncLoRA stages. All current FAA/AAA/BWT and archived IncLoRA FAA agree to <1e-10.
limitations: Single seed0: no estimate of seed variability or statistical significance; across-Order variance is not seed uncertainty.
G2 changes optimizer gradient sampling to three CE gradient reads versus one for IncLoRA; equal update/sample budget is not equal compute budget.
Current transport uses NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 after default-transport witness timed out; historical run has no such override. Both use DDP4; numerical transport equivalence is not claimed.
Current explicit max_steps equals historical actual full accumulation window count. Current logging_steps=1 versus baseline10 is instrumentation only.
Historical IncLoRA carries inactive ewclora_lambda=1 but strategy inclora has zero Fisher updates and zero EWC gradient; current sets lambda0 explicitly.
